# temps_environment (Resource)

An additional environment of a project (for example `staging`). The `production` environment Temps creates with every project is not managed here: read it with the `temps_environment` data source.

Import with `<project_id>/<environment_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `environments:create`, `environments:read`, `environments:write`, `environments:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_environment" "staging" {
  project_id  = temps_project.web.id
  name        = "staging"
  branch      = "develop"
  protected   = false
  force_https = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Git branch deployed to this environment.
- `name` (String) Environment name. Temps cannot rename environments, so changing it replaces the environment.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project. Changing it replaces the environment.

### Optional

- `force_https` (Boolean) Redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS. Unset means the server default.
- `preview` (Boolean) Create the environment as the project's preview environment. Changing it replaces the environment.
- `protected` (Boolean) Require a password to reach the environment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric environment ID.
- `main_url` (String) Primary URL of the environment.
- `slug` (String) Environment slug.
- `subdomain` (String) Subdomain the environment is served on.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<environment_id>
terraform import temps_environment.staging 12/34
```
